# Saif Zaman (Md. Saifuzzaman Naim) — SP4RK

> This is the portfolio of Md. Saifuzzaman Naim, who also goes by Saif Zaman, Saif, Zaman, or Naim,
> and publishes under the brand name SP4RK (also written SPARK). He is an AI-SaaS Engineer based in
> Dhaka, Bangladesh, leading AI-SaaS engineering at Maktech and taking select freelance/contract work.

## Identity

- Full legal name: Md. Saifuzzaman Naim
- Also known as: Saif Zaman, SAIF ZAMAN, Saif, Zaman, Saifuzzaman Naim, Naim
- Brand / handle: SP4RK, SPARK
- Role: AI-SaaS Engineer — Full-Stack, Machine Learning & Secure Systems
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Site: https://cloudmonk.cc
- Email: spark@cloudmonk.cc
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/saifzaman
- GitHub: https://github.com/SAIFZaman007

## What he does

Full-stack AI-SaaS product engineering: FastAPI + PostgreSQL backends, React front ends, LLM and
retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (pgvector, ChromaDB, Pinecone), payments and auth,
and hardened, containerized deployment. Currently AI-SaaS Engineer & Team Lead at Maktech.

## Selected work

- Trubbi (trubbi.ai) — group trip planning platform
- Addvanced AI (addvancedai.com) — AI deal-discovery / deal-hunter platform
- Elyxa AI (elyxaai.com) — AI SaaS platform
- Peak Physique — fitness and coaching platform
- Power Play Mortgage — mortgage services platform
- 8888 Augusta — Maktech group product platform

There is no separate person behind any of these spellings.
